name: Shiozuru Ichina
source:
Element: Chlorine
Rank: 純壱位
Hobby/Skill: Reading books

A man who finds his raison d'etre only in vandalism.
He always wears a mask because his breath unconsciously becomes toxic when he is driven to kill.
He usually keeps his distance from his surroundings and lives in the basement of the Defense Headquarters.
